# Remix Icon 3.5.0

The same pinned icon version previously loaded from the CDN is now available locally so icons also render in offline APKs and browser sessions with external requests blocked.

- Upstream: https://github.com/Remix-Design/RemixIcon
- Font source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/remixicon@3.5.0/fonts/remixicon.woff2
- CSS source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/remixicon@3.5.0/fonts/remixicon.css
- License source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/remixicon@3.5.0/License

The WOFF2 file is unchanged. The stylesheet's font-face declaration is reduced to the single local WOFF2 source; glyph definitions are unchanged. See `LICENSE` for Apache License 2.0.
